digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles before the production cutover in S8, using layered config file rather than deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL.
A real local gate run against a real ticket on Bedrock must return a parseable verdict with provider provenance metadata and zero direct Anthropic calls.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path, demonstrated by nonzero cache_read_tokens in the usage log across multiple gate invocations, not only cache_write.
All three developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must be exercised end-to-end on Bedrock and their outcomes recorded with resolved model ids per pass.
The Bedrock cachePoint TTL behavior relative to Anthropic cache_control must be stated with evidence, including whether the missing explicit TTL causes observable differences.
Local Bedrock opt-in and single-step revert to Anthropic must be documented in docs/local-dev-env.md and the revert must be executed and proven to work.
